_comment: Guided tour of the switch-user window. Targets are controls of the emtk app: spec fields by attr, buttons by action name.

steps.title: Which server
steps.text: The Server is where the MMFDB runs; 127.0.0.1 is this computer. Pick a server you used before with Recent servers, or type one. A remote MMFDB is addressed by a URL instead and has no port.

steps.title: Which account
steps.text: Type the account name, or use Select user for the configured account and the desktop accounts. Leave it empty and the account last picked from the list is used.

await.hint: Edit the User field and press Enter.

steps.title: The password
steps.text: The password is shown as stars and is never stored. An account that may sign in without a password accepts an empty one.

steps.title: What is remembered
steps.text: Save selected user makes this the default account at the next start. Log in automatically when allowed also keeps a session token in the operating system's credential store.

await.hint: Tick or untick Log in automatically.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.text: Login asks the MMFDB. A refusal is shown in a message and nothing changes; on success the choice is saved and the window closes. Cancel closes it without changing anything.
